usage: cli.py diff-strategy-brief [-h] --left-strategy LEFT_STRATEGY
                                  --left-meta LEFT_META
                                  --right-strategy RIGHT_STRATEGY
                                  --right-meta RIGHT_META --out OUT
                                  [--meta-out META_OUT]
                                  [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-only]
                                  [--refresh] [--render-md RENDER_MD]
                                  [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --left-strategy LEFT_STRATEGY
                        Left strategy JSON path
  --left-meta LEFT_META
                        Left strategy meta JSON path
  --right-strategy RIGHT_STRATEGY
                        Right strategy JSON path
  --right-meta RIGHT_META
                        Right strategy meta JSON path
  --out OUT             Output diff JSON path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output diff meta JSON path
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not recompute.
  --refresh             Recompute even if cache exists.
  --render-md RENDER_MD
                        Optional output markdown path
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
